item.description:
Hold My Notes 1.0.11

  • Fixes a crash: undoing a deleted note twice (from the toast and with ⌘Z, or after sync had already brought it back) could quit the app on the next keystroke, in any note
  • Fixes a freeze: deleting text inside a bold word above a list could leave the note ignoring everything typed after it
  • Deleting a note is now ⇧⌘⌫, so ⌘⌫ deletes the line before the caret as it does everywhere on the Mac. The toast that follows counts down its ten seconds, with Undo beside it
  • Sync: a note deleted on one Mac stays deleted on every Mac, and the sync folder clears its old delete markers on its own
  • Drag a note by the empty part of its header, next to the title
  • ⌘Z after flipping to another note and back no longer acts on the note you left
  • The checklist button keeps a line with an emoji intact
